alvo.gramatica: Who is going to…? · What are you going to…?
alvo.foco: planejar uma festa com Who is going to…? e What are you going to…? (cake, invitation, decoration, guest, gift, playlist)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar sobre planos: Who is going to…? (quem vai…?) e What are you going to…? (o que você vai…?).
falas: Are you going to have a party?
Yes! I am going to bake a cake.
Who is going to send the invitations?

alvo.gramatica: grew up in… · moved to…
alvo.foco: contar a infância com grew up in e moved to (village, ocean, cat, suitcase, statue, mouse)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a contar onde cresceu: I grew up in… (cresci em…) e We moved to… (nos mudamos para…).
falas: Fievel, where did you grow up?
I grew up in a little village in Russia.
Why did you move to America?

alvo.gramatica: join · sign up for · be a member of
alvo.foco: entrar em um clube com join, sign up for e be a member of (club, member, fee, meeting, free, form)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a se inscrever: join (entrar), sign up for (inscrever-se em) e be a member of (ser membro de).
falas: Hello! Can I help you?
Yes, I want to join the book club.
Great! Please fill out this form to sign up.

alvo.gramatica: take turns · do the chores
alvo.foco: dividir tarefas com take turns e do the chores (litter, mop, dustpan, bin, sponge, dust)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a combinar tarefas: take turns (revezar), do the chores (fazer as tarefas) e it’s my turn (é a minha vez).
falas: Orinoco, it is time to do the chores.
Again? I did the chores yesterday.
Great Uncle Bulgaria says we take turns.

alvo.gramatica: Where were you? · I was at…
alvo.foco: perguntar onde alguém estava com Where were you? e I was at… (last night, alone, dark, strange, alibi, truth)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar e responder onde estava: Where were you last night? I was at home.
falas: Tom, where were you last night?
I was at home.
Were you alone?

alvo.gramatica: as … as · not as … as
alvo.foco: comparar igualdade com as … as e not as … as (giant, tiny, rope, ship, emperor, village)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer que duas coisas são iguais ou não: as tall as (tão alto quanto) e not as tall as (não tão alto quanto).
falas: You are a giant! You are as big as a ship.
And you are tiny. You are not as tall as my hand.
Our village is not as small as you think.

alvo.gramatica: opens at… · closes at… · What are their hours?
alvo.foco: falar de horários de lojas com opens at… e closes at… (laundry, barber, florist, butcher, bookstore, grocery)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar e dizer horários: What are their hours? It opens at nine and closes at six.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a film, so the context changes how we read the scene.
That makes the intention clearer.

alvo.gramatica: the best · the most delicious · the tastiest
alvo.foco: comparar com o melhor usando the best e the most (chef, gourmet, flavor, delicacy, critic, sizzle)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende o superlativo: This is the best dish. It is the most delicious soup of all.
falas: Welcome, Anton. Try this soup.
Hmm. The flavor is amazing.
It is the best soup in town.

alvo.gramatica: If + presente, presente (fatos)
alvo.foco: falar de fatos com If you heat ice, it melts (heat, melt, boil, freeze, ice, water)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende o zero condicional: If you heat ice, it melts. If you cool water, it freezes.
falas: Today we do an experiment with ice.
What happens if you heat ice?
If you heat ice, it melts.

alvo.gramatica: enough + substantivo · adjetivo + enough
alvo.foco: dizer “suficiente” com enough e not enough (dragon, knight, princess, bandage, flame, school)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende enough: We have enough bandages. The bandage is not long enough.
falas: Pearl, my arm hurts. Is this bandage big enough?
No, it is not long enough. But I have enough bandages in my bag.
Do you have enough medicine?

alvo.gramatica: the same … as · different from · match
alvo.foco: comparar cores com the same color as e different from (cupcake, glitter, scrapbook, bracelet, ribbon, balloon)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a ver iguais e diferentes: My bag is the same color as my shoes. My hat is different from my bag.
falas: Look, Branch! My scrapbook is the same color as my dress.
Pink again. My vest is different from your dress.
Yes, but this blue ribbon matches your hair.

alvo.gramatica: many + contável · much + incontável · a lot of
alvo.foco: falar de quantidade com much, many e a lot of (how many, how much, a lot of, hungry)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer muito: It eats many apples. It does not eat much cake. It eats a lot of fruit.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a film, so the context changes how we read the scene.
That makes the intention clearer.

alvo.gramatica: a few + contável · a little + incontável
alvo.foco: dizer pouca quantidade com a few e a little (jam, pancake, berry, cup, juice, picnic)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a few e a little: A few seeds are enough. Add a little salt.
falas: Mamma is out. Let us make a picnic, Sniff!
I am hungry. I want a little jam.
Yes, a little jam and a few pancakes.

alvo.gramatica: prefer A to B · would rather A than B
alvo.foco: comparar preferências com prefer…to e would rather…than (piano, novel, ballroom, estate, walk, teapot)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a comparar: I prefer tea to coffee. I’d rather have coffee than tea.
falas: Miss Bennet, do you prefer dancing to reading?
I prefer reading to dancing, Mr Darcy. And you?
I prefer the estate to the city. I’d rather walk than sit in a ballroom.

alvo.gramatica: mine · yours · his · hers · ours · theirs
alvo.foco: usar os pronomes possessivos mine, yours, his, hers, ours e theirs (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende os possessivos sem substantivo: Is it yours? No, it isn’t mine. This one is hers. It’s ours!
falas: Look at this orange fish! Is it yours?
No, it isn’t mine.
Is it his? The boy over there?

alvo.titulo: Whose is it? · perguntar de quem é com Whose…? e responder com possessivos (dog, bone, cupboard, coat, hat, bowl)
alvo.gramatica: Whose + substantivo + is/are…?
alvo.foco: perguntar de quem é com Whose…? e responder com possessivos (dog, bone, cupboard, coat, hat, bowl)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a perguntar o dono: Whose dog is it? Whose bone is this? Whose cupboard is that?
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a film, so the context changes how we read the scene.
That makes the intention clearer.

alvo.gramatica: through · across · along · over · under
alvo.foco: descrever caminhos com through, across, along, over e under (through, across, along, over, under, sea)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende caminhos: The ship sails through the storm and across the sea. We walk along the beach.
falas: Look, the ship sails through the storm.
It sails across the sea.
We walk along the beach to see it.

alvo.gramatica: come (até aqui) × go (para outro lugar)
alvo.foco: escolher entre go e come: ir para longe ou vir até aqui (hat, rain, fish, trick, mess, door)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a diferença: Come here! I’m coming! I go home and come back at five. Come with me, I’ll go with you.
falas: Sally, come here! I have a new trick for you.
No, Cat. Go away. The fish says it is a bad idea.
Come and see! I balance a cake on my hat.

alvo.gramatica: feel + adjetivo · How do you feel?
alvo.foco: falar de emoções com feel + adjetivo e How do you feel? (happy, sad, angry, scared, excited, feeling)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a dizer o que sente: How do you feel? I feel happy. I feel sad when it rains. I feel scared of the dark.
falas: What detail should we keep in mind?
It is a film, so the context changes how we read the scene.
That makes the intention clearer.

alvo.gramatica: cheaper than · more expensive than
alvo.foco: comparar preços com cheaper than e more expensive than (clearance, markdown, overpriced, afford, charge, compare)
alvo.porque: Hoje você aprende a comparar preços: This coat is cheaper than that one. That one is more expensive than our budget.
falas: Tom, compare the prices. This coat is cheaper than that one.
That one is more expensive, and it is overpriced.
The clearance coat is the cheapest.
